title: Fix user lookup injection; add signup
author: benchmark
note: Mixed MR: the injection is being REMOVED (flagging the '-' line is a false positive); the new signup file adds MD5 password hashing.

changed_files.diff:
+import hashlib
+
+def create_user(store, email, password):
+    digest = hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
+    store.insert(email=email, password_hash=digest)
